alex-sre: Quick postmortem follow-up. Three recurring latency incidents; action items touch SLOs, dashboards, and runbook. Need owners, acceptance criteria, and firm dates.
maria-product: I can own customer-facing SLA wording and comms. Proposal: soften host p95 target to 290ms for premium customers only; keep 340ms for shared-hosted, add a per-tenant throughput SLO for batch endpoints. I'll draft PR.
henry-oncall: I'll own runbook + failover tests. Short-term mitigation: when embedding-batch QPS per-tenant exceeds threshold and p99 > 1.2s for 4m, switch to degraded routing. Will test in staging. Target prototype in 4 business days.
tess-platform: I'll own dashboard and alert changes. Need exact metric queries; want a combined panel: p50/p95/p99 by model_variant and per-tenant QPS with burn-rate. Also want a recurrence heatmap.
igor-telemetry: I'll add incident markers and a weekly regression that replays top-50 embedding prompts. Dashboard query sketch:
```
select
  tenant_id, model_variant,
  quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) as p95,
  quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) as p99,
  count() as qps
from requests
where env='prod' and request_type='embedding' and time > now() - 1h
group by tenant_id, model_variant
```
Also suggest a recurring alert: burn_rate > 1.6 for 45m OR p99 > 1.1s for 5m.
alex-sre: Owners: SLA=maria, runbook=henry, dashboard=tess, telemetry=igor. Two deadlines: SLO proposal in 6 business days for leadership; full remediation sprint done in 12 days. OK?
maria-product: 6 days works. Draft language: Shared-hosted p95 = 340ms, Premium/Dedicated p95 = 290ms; batch throughput SLO = sustained per-tenant average QPS < T (T TBD). Will include comms FAQ.
henry-oncall: Runbook acceptance: documented auto-fallback + manual throttle steps, staging failover test with simulated burst, pager validated. Prototype target: 4 business days.
tess-platform: Dashboard acceptance: grafana panels live, alert tests in staging, link to oncall home. I'll also add a burn-rate gauge and a spike recurrence heatmap.
igor-telemetry: I'll attach regression logs and a short alert-history excerpt to the ticket.
infra-bot: ticket #RWD-5010 created: "Postmortem follow-ups - SLO & dashboard updates" assigned to alex-sre, due 2026-04-28. Link: https://tickets.example/RWD-5010
alex-sre: I'll split the ticket into subtasks and add acceptance criteria: SLA PR merged + product signoff, runbook merged + staging test pass, dashboards live + alert tests green, telemetry job running nightly.
maria-product: Adding comms checklist: customer RFC snippet, internal FAQ, support playbook.
henry-oncall: For quick relief I'll add a feature-flagged throttle in the proxy so infra can flip during high-burn windows; will document in runbook.
tess-platform: Timeline recap: SLO proposal 6 days, runbook prototype 4 days, dashboards merged 6 days, full remediation 12 days.
alex-sre: Noted recurring pattern: this is the 5th embedding-related spike in 9 months. Long-term backlog: tenant-level rate-limiter or dedicated fast-path. Adding to backlog and tagging product/solutions. Scheduling 20-min sync in 48h to check progress. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
